info.description: Afinis is a diverse group of organizations working to support advancement and use of API standardization in the financial services industry. Utilization of this API requires a developer to [register](https://www.afinis.org/user/register) their application.
info.title: Payee Profile API

get.summary: Get Participants Profile with unique identification

parameters.name: requestordid
parameters.description: Unique identification, as assigned by directory service, to unambiguously identify the requestor participant

parameters.name: counterpartydid
parameters.description: Unique identification, as assigned by directory service, to unambiguously identify the Payee participant

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: Optional Request ID allows application developer to trace requests through the systems logs

403.description: Access denied, the operation is not allowed

requestStatus.description:
Specifies the status of the request:
  * `APRV` - Approved by Payee
  * `PDNG` - CSP waiting on decision by Payee
  * `DENY` - Denied by Payee

counterpartydid.description: Unique identification, as assigned by directory service, to unambiguously identify the Payee participant

creationDateTime.description: The date and time the API response is created. Date should be in YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ format.

deliveryMethod.title: Delivery Method
deliveryMethod.description: Specifies the delivery method of the cheque by the debtor's agent

paymentMethod.title: Payment Method
paymentMethod.description:
Specifies the means of payment that will be used to move the amount of money:
  * `CHK` - Cheque
  * `TRF` - CreditTransfer

paymentTypeInformation.title: Payment Type Information
paymentTypeInformation.description: Set of elements used to further specify the type of transaction.

serviceLevel.title: Service Level
serviceLevel.description:
Specifies a pre-agreed service or level of service between the parties, as published in an external service level code list:
  * `NURG` - Non-urgent Payment
  * `URGP` - Urgent Payment
  * `CARD` - Credit Card
  * `SDVA` - Same Day Value Payment

relatedRemittanceInformation.title: Related Remittance Information
relatedRemittanceInformation.description: Provides information related to the handling of the remittance information by any of the agents in the transaction processing chain

method.description:
Method used to deliver the remittance advice information:
 * `WPMT` - WithPayment - Remittance advice information must be sent with payment
 * `EMAL` - Email - Remittance advice information must be through e-mail
 * `FAXI` - Fax - Remittance advice information must be faxed
 * `URID` - Uniform Resource Identifier
 * `POST` - Post
 * `SMSM` - SMS

electronicAddress.title: Electronic Address
electronicAddress.description: Electronic address to which an agent is to send the remittance information

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Unique reference, as assigned by the creditor, to unambiguously refer to the payment transaction

number.title: Number
number.description: Unique and unambiguous identification of the referred document

relatedDate.title: Related Date
relatedDate.description: Date associated with the referred document

invoicee.title: Invoicee
invoicee.description: Unambiguous identification of the account number

identification.title: Identification
identification.description: Unambiguous identification of the account number

creditor.title: Creditor
creditor.description: Party to which an amount of money is due.

length.description: Total length of the Account number

minLength.description: Total length of the Account number

maxLength.description: Total length of the Account number

identification.description: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a credit entry will be posted as a result of the payment transaction.

alternateAccount.description: Exception bank account number to be used when mask criteria is not met.

type.description:
Identification used to indicate the account identification:
 * `EMAL` - Email - Receiver's Email
 * `MBNO` - Mobile Number - Receiver's Phone Number

minimumAmount.title: Minimum Amount
minimumAmount.description: Minimum amount of payment accepted by supplier for the payment type selected

maximumAmount.title: Maximum Amount
maximumAmount.description: Maximum amount of payment accepted by supplier for the payment type selected

duePayableAmount.title: Due Payable Amount
duePayableAmount.description: Amount specified is the exact amount due and payable to the creditor

discountAppliedAmount.title: Discount Applied Amount
discountAppliedAmount.description: Amount specified for the referred document is the amount of discount to be applied to the amount due and payable to the creditor

amount.description: Amount of money of the document adjustment.

reason.description: Specifies the reason for the adjustment.

additionalInformation.description: Provides further details on the document adjustment

creditorAgent.title: Creditor Agent
creditorAgent.description: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.

clearingSystemIdentification.description:
Specification of a pre-agreed offering between clearing agents or the channel through which the payment instruction is processed:  
  * `CACPA` - Bank Branch Code used in Canada.
  * `USABA` - Routing Transit number assigned by the ABA for US financial Institutions.

memberIdentification.description: Identification of a member of a clearing system  e.g., a U.S. transit routing number or Canadian Payments Association Routing Number

address.description: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services

department.description: Identification of a division of a large organisation or building

streetName.description: Name of a street or thoroughfare

postCode.description: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail

townName.description: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government

countrySubDivision.description: Identifies a subdivision of a country such as state, region, county

locationAndContact.description: Location and contact information of the merchant (business) performing the transaction

URLAddress.description: Address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), for example used over the www (HTTP) service

customerService.description: Phone number of the customer service

contactDetails.title: Contact Details
contactDetails.description: Set of elements used to indicate how to contact the party

name.description: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party

phoneNumber.description: Collection of information that identifies a phone number, as defined by telecom services

errorCode.description:
A programmatic error code:
  * `2000` - Invalid JSON structure.
  * `2001` - [Field name] is missing or invalid.
  * `2002` - Invalid date.
  * `2003` - Invalid combination of fields submitted. Check the API specification for eligible combinations.  
  * `2004` - [Field name] cannot be more than [max number] characters.

message.description: A human readable description of the problem

errorCode.description:
A programmatic error code:
  * `1000` - API key is missing, invalid or expired. 
  * `1001` - API token is invalid, expired, or account associated with key does not have access to that API.

message.description: A human readable description of the problem
message.example: API key is missing, invalid or expired.

errorCode.description:
A programmatic error code:
  * `4001` - Unprocessable request due to "%%"

message.description: A human readable description of the problem
message.example: Unprocessable request due to duplicate records

errorCode.description:
A programmatic error code:
  * `3001` - Internal Server error.

message.description: A human readable description of the problem
